description: This file defines the PHPMailer POP3 class used for RFC1939 POP-before-SMTP authentication, including connection, login, and error handling functionalities.

classes.name: POP3
classes.description: Class implementing lightweight POP3 protocol for POP-before-SMTP authentication, including connection, login, disconnect, and error handling.

methods.name: popBeforeSmtp
methods.description: Static method to perform all-in-one POP-before-SMTP authentication.

methods.name: authorise
methods.description: Performs connect, login, and disconnect sequence for POP3 server authentication.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the POP3 server.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Logs in to the POP3 server with provided credentials.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Closes the connection to the POP3 server.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Retrieves a response line from the server.

methods.name: sendString
methods.description: Sends raw string data to the server.

methods.name: checkResponse
methods.description: Checks server response for success (+OK) or error.

methods.name: setError
methods.description: Stores and optionally displays an error message.

methods.name: getErrors
methods.description: Returns the list of error messages.

methods.name: catchWarning
methods.description: Handles PHP warnings during socket connection attempts.
